name: opaque-xrpl
description: Opaque on the XRP Ledger: private XRP and RLUSD, single-use keys, private access to XRPL dapps.

scripts.smoke: npm pack --silent && D=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf opaque-xrpl-*.tgz -C $D && cp -r test/fixtures $D/fixtures && node $D/package/bin/nonce0.js scan $D/fixtures --json; rm -rf $D opaque-xrpl-*.tgz
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm --prefix packages/protocol-types test && npm --prefix packages/pq-wallet test && npm --prefix packages/ring-client test && npm --prefix graph test && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.typecheck:all: npm --prefix packages/protocol-types run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/pq-wallet run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/ring-client run typecheck && npm --prefix graph run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck

comment: Runs .ts directly: Node >=22.18 strips types, so there is no build step.
Built on Opaque (github.com/minrawsjar/Opaque), flattened into this repo;
No dependencies here, and no root node_modules: test/deps.test.js holds the
scanner to zero, and Node's upward resolution would let src/ reach a root
install. xrpl lives in backend/package.json, beside the code that uses it.
